items.title: 68163_Tom Whaley oral history interview
items.q: Yeah. He was around there with Fats and I, and he used to kid me.

ctx.x: Anyway, I thought Bill Vodery was great, stand up there and write with all that going on. Well, I did it myself at the Lafayette Theatre; I sat there and I used to orchestrate and Luther Henderson, he says he saw me doing that -- this was before Luther got big, you
know, and Luther said he saw me writing among all that turmoil and he said that was great.

And then he went on and became great himself.
Luther Henderson.
